mapper.sql: -- 현재 할당된 총액을 계산 (NULL인 경우 0으로 처리) COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, -- 잔여액 계산 = 총 보유액 - 현재 할당된 총액 (acc.account_balance - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount
mapper.select: SELECT acc.account_id as member_product_id, acc.account_number, acc.account_name, acc.account_balance as present_amount, 0 as allocated_amount, acc.account_balance as remaining_amount, 0 as checked FROM account acc WHERE acc.member_id = #{memberId} AND acc.is_deleted = false AND acc.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' -- 예적금 계좌만 필터링 ORDER BY acc.created_at DESC

SELECT acc.account_id as member_product_id, acc.account_number, acc.account_name, acc.account_balance as present_amount, 1 as checked, COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, (acc.account_balance - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount FROM account acc -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.account_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.account_type = 'Deposit' GROUP BY a.account_id ) allocated_sum ON acc.account_id = allocated_sum.account_id INNER JOIN action a ON acc.account_id = a.account_id WHERE acc.member_id = #{memberId} AND acc.is_deleted = false AND acc.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' -- 예적금 계좌만 필터링 AND a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND a.is_deleted = false AND a.account_type = 'Deposit' -- action 테이블에서도 예적금만 필터링 ORDER BY acc.account_id DESC

SELECT acc.account_id as member_product_id, acc.account_number, acc.account_name, acc.account_balance as present_amount, 0 as checked, (acc.account_balance - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount FROM account acc -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.account_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.account_type = 'Deposit' GROUP BY a.account_id ) allocated_sum ON acc.account_id = allocated_sum.account_id WHERE acc.member_id = #{memberId} AND acc.is_deleted = false AND acc.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' -- 예적금 계좌만 필터링 -- 잔여액이 0보다 큰 계좌만 조회 (할당 가능한 계좌) AND (acc.account_balance - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) > 0 -- 해당 목적에 할당되지 않은 계좌들만 조회 AND acc.account_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM action WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false ) ORDER BY acc.created_at DESC

( #{req.goalId}, #{req.accountNumber}, #{req.memberAccountId}, #{req.accountAllocatedRate}, #{req.accountType}, #{req.amount} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE action SET is_deleted = CASE
WHEN goal_id = #{req.goalId} AND member_product_id = #{req.memberAccountId} THEN true
ELSE is_deleted END, updated_at = CASE
WHEN goal_id = #{req.goalId} AND member_product_id = #{req.memberAccountId} THEN NOW()
ELSE updated_at END WHERE (goal_id, member_product_id) IN (
(#{req.goalId}, #{req.memberAccountId})
) AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO action ( goal_id, member_product_id, account_number, account_type, amount, allocated_rate, account_allocated_rate, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{req.goalId}, #{req.memberAccountId}, #{req.accountNumber}, #{req.accountType}, #{req.amount}, #{req.allocatedRate}, #{req.accountAllocatedRate}, false, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_number = VALUES(account_number), account_type = VALUES(account_type), amount = VALUES(amount), allocated_rate = VALUES(allocated_rate), account_allocated_rate = VALUES(account_allocated_rate), is_deleted = false, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM action WHERE account_id = #{memberAccountId} AND is_deleted = false AND account_type = 'Deposit'
